user_query: Identify likely function of this protein, subcellular localization, and biological processes. Distinguish direct/curated annotation from inference based on homologs; report evidence and uncertainty.

function: Located on the platform of the 30S subunit, it bridges several disparate RNA helices of the 16S rRNA. Forms part of the Shine-Dalgarno cleft in the 70S ribosome.
subunit: Part of the 30S ribosomal subunit. Interacts with proteins S7 and S18. Binds to IF-3.
similarity: Belongs to the universal ribosomal protein uS11 family.
